news.contents: A.J. Brown hauled in 3-of-6 targets for 48 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.analysis: Since returning from a four-week absence, Brown has now secured just 6-of-16 targets for 75 yards over the last two games. He looked a little more up to speed Thursday night, but he's still well below the top-tier fantasy option he once was. Better games should be on the way from Brown, but right now, he's difficult to trust in fantasy lineups.
news.title: A.J. Brown grabs three passes in Thursday's loss

news.contents: New England Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown was looking for a bounce-back game on Thursday night on the road against the Chicago Bears, but it did not come. Brown came off Injured Reserve last weekend for Sunday's 26-19 victory over the division-rival New York Jets, but he battled drops and finished with only three catches on 10 targets for 27 yards.
